Usage

You do not need to read this first. Open a demo and follow the thrush's guide, and you will mostly learn how the screen works. If something is unclear, ask in the chat on the right. The Agent knows the open project and the operations on screen.

The first five minutes

The steps are in the README's First steps. The first time you open the app, after entering an API key (which you can skip), the thrush in the bottom right asks "What would you like to do?" and takes you to a demo chosen by field or from the Drafts.

The screen

WhereWhat is there
Centre (Canvas)Cards, wires and the outputs' displays
Right (chat)Requests and questions to the Agent (the thrush)
Left (sidebar)The hierarchy of Workflows and the list of Cards
Bottom (panel)The run's state, logs and the timeline

Operations you use most

ToDo
Run or stopThe buttons at the top of the Canvas
Place a DraftPress E and write its content on the card (a name is optional)
Place a CardRight-click the Canvas and choose "Add Card"
ConnectDrag from an output port (dropped anywhere on a Draft, it connects)
See or fix what is inside a Cards, or "Settings" in the context menu (source, ports, Nix definition, run history)
Run only this Card"Run Only This Card (Last Inputs)" in the context menu
Run from this Card downstream"Run from Here Downstream" in the context menu
Leave implementation to the Agent"Generate Cards", at the top right when there are Drafts
Go inside a child WorkflowDouble-click
Move and zoomDrag to pan; pinch or ⌘ + scroll to zoom
Duplicate, select a rangec; Shift + drag
Go back HomeThe house button at the top right of the Canvas, or ⌘⇧H (after any save that is needed; not while running)
